title: Multiwythe walls.
officialText:
The fire-resistance rating for walls or partitions consisting of two or more dissimilar wythes shall be permitted to be determined by the formula: R = (R 0.59 +R 0.59 + ...+R 0.59) 1.7 (Equation 7-11) 1 2 n where: R = The fire endurance of the assembly (hours).

R1, R and R = The fire endurance of the individual wythes (hours). 2 n Values for R 0.59 for use in Equation 7-11 are given in Table 721.4.1(3). n
